errors.text: The proposed alloying intervention does not reconstruct the target study's crystallographic-orientation, temperature, and strain-rate investigation.
Neither alloying concentration nor an actual temperature and strain-rate range is defined.
Particle strengthening in Hf- or Mo-modified FeNiCrMn is asserted without evidence that such particles form in this alloy.
The cited studies concern different alloy systems and mostly elevated-temperature or static properties, not dynamic loading of Co-free FeNiCrMn.
The proposal does not address whether costly Hf or Mo preserves the cost constraint or whether strengthening sacrifices ductility.
The intervention is not singular because it leaves the choice between Hf and Mo unresolved.
The falsification experiment lacks specified dynamic strain rates, temperatures, compositions, quantitative success thresholds, and measurements capable of testing the claimed mechanism.
